MiniCI — See What Every Pull Request Costs Before You Merge

AI coding and rapid shipping have created a 10× Pull Request storm — yet CI/CD billing stays invisible until the month-end invoice lands.
Meanwhile, developers lose hours in slow queues and reruns with zero cost or time visibility per workflow, build phase, or step.
MiniCI posts the estimated compute delta, developer wait-time cost, and 1-click YAML fixes right on every Pull Request in under 2 ms — with zero API keys and zero external code uploads.

PR Preview · Action Quickstart · CLI Quickstart · AI Agent Skill · Permissions & Security · Inputs & Outputs · Troubleshooting · FAQ

--- ## GitHub Action: What It Does MiniCI estimates what each Pull Request adds to your CI/CD bill and developer wait time, posts one sticky PR comment, and suggests verified YAML patches (`shrink` + ARM64). It runs on your runner, works without an API key, and uploads no code. Website: **[minici.dev](https://minici.dev)** ## Usage ```yaml - uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: { fetch-depth: 0 } - uses: minici-dev/minici-cost-action@v1 with: compare-to: origin/${{ github.base_ref }} post-pr-comment: "true" ``` Give the job `pull-requests: write` so the sticky comment can be posted. | Input | Default | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `compare-to` | `""` | Base ref for the Pull Request cost delta | | `post-pr-comment` | `false` | Post or update one sticky PR comment | | `tier` | `auto` | Plan quota tier | | `dev-hourly-rate` | `65` | Hourly rate for wait-time cost | | `billing-csv` | `""` | Optional invoice CSV for exact billing | | `api-url` | `https://minici.dev` | API origin override (used with `cloud-key`) | | Output | Meaning | | :--- | :--- | | `gross_monthly_compute_cost_usd` | Gross monthly CI compute cost (USD) | | `net_billed_monthly_compute_cost_usd` | Net billed monthly cost after the free-tier allowance (USD) | | `cost_per_merged_pr_usd` | Cost per merged Pull Request (USD) | | `recoverable_ci_and_wait_monthly_usd` | Recoverable CI and wait cost per month (USD) | Read outputs as `steps..outputs.`. Full lists: [Action Inputs & Outputs](#action-inputs--outputs). --- ## What Your Team Sees on Every Pull Request MiniCI runs non-blocking (`exit 0`), updates **one sticky comment** per PR, and attaches committable **Files changed** suggestions when workflow waste is detected: > ### 💰 MiniCI Pull Request CI/CD Cost Diff (`433 µs` • Non-Blocking) > > | Metric | Base Branch | This PR | Impact (`Before → After`) | > | :--- | ---: | ---: | :--- | > | **Expanded Matrix Jobs** | 1 job | 8 jobs | **+7 matrix jobs** | > | **Billed Minutes / Run** | 4.0 min | 44.0 min | **+40.0 min / run** (incl. 4.0m rounding overhead) | > | **Monthly CI Compute** | `$10.39/mo` | `$413.08/mo` | **`+$402.69/mo`** | > | **Developer Wait-Time Impact** | `$723.11/mo` | `$2,701.92/mo` | **`+$1,978.81/mo`** (14.4m critical path) | > > **Changed Cost Drivers & Phase Bottlenecks:** > - **Added `release.yml • build-matrix [macos-latest]`** (`2x macos-latest` at `$0.0620/m`) → **`+$322.15/mo`** (`10×` free-tier multiplier) > - **Added `release.yml • verify-gates & linux/windows matrix`** (`5` jobs) → **`+$80.54/mo`** > - **Top Build Phase Bottleneck (`dependency_install`):** Uncached Cargo/step setup across 7/8 jobs wastes **`~$224.34/mo`**; missing `cancel-in-progress` wastes **`~$61.96/mo`** on superseded PR pushes. > > **✂️ Verified 1-Click YAML Fixes Ready:** Click **Commit suggestion** on *Files changed* (or comment `@minici shrink`): > ```diff > # .github/workflows/ci.yml > + concurrency: > + group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }} > + cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }} > jobs: > verify-action: > - runs-on: ubuntu-latest > + runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm > + timeout-minutes: 30 > ``` --- ## Why Engineering Teams Adopt MiniCI | Without MiniCI | With MiniCI | | :--- | :--- | | **Month-end invoice shock** after 10× PR storms and silent `OS × version × shard` matrix fan-out | **Pre-merge dollar delta on every PR** (`exit 0` sticky comment + GitHub Step Summary) | | **Zero visibility per build phase or step** (1-min ceiling rounding, 10× macOS burn, artifact retention bloat) | **6-phase & step-signal breakdown** across 7 CI platforms and 227+ runner & cloud VM rates | | **Wasted developer hours** waiting on uncached installs, slow critical paths, and obsolete PR pushes | **Critical-path wait-time pricing + 1-click YAML fixes** (`minici shrink` & verified `ARM64` right-sizing) | | **Heavy external SaaS tools** requiring sign-ups, API keys, and cloud access to proprietary repos | **Standalone 1.6 MB Rust binary** (0 third-party crates, 0 API keys, 0 external data egress) | --- ## 15-Second GitHub Action Quickstart Create `.github/workflows/minici-cost.yml` (or scaffold automatically via `minici init-hooks --path .`): ```yaml name: CI Cost Diff on: pull_request: permissions: contents: read # Reads workflow YAML on your runner — zero external egress pull-requests: write # Posts & updates one sticky PR cost comment jobs: ci-cost: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: fetch-depth: 0 # Needed to compare PR workflows against the base branch - name: MiniCI PR Cost Diff & 1-Click Fixes id: cost uses: minici-dev/minici-cost-action@v1 with: compare-to: "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}" post-pr-comment: "true" suggest-fixes: "true" ```
Enable Interactive @minici PR Bot + Slack Alerts Reply `@minici shrink`, `@minici accelerate`, `@minici migrate arm64`, `@minici permissions`, or `@minici ask ""` directly on any PR (or wire org-wide across GitHub App `/webhooks/github`, Slack `/slack/interactions`, Linear `/webhooks/linear`, Jira `/webhooks/jira`, and Google Chat `/webhooks/gchat`): ```yaml name: CI Cost Diff & @minici Bot on: pull_request: types: [opened, synchronize, reopened] issue_comment: types: [created] concurrency: group: minici-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || github.ref }} cancel-in-progress: true permissions: contents: read pull-requests: write issues: write jobs: ci-cost: if: >- github.event_name != 'issue_comment' || (github.event.issue.pull_request && github.event.comment.user.type != 'Bot' && !contains(github.event.comment.body, '`) | | `suggest-fixes` | `true` | Attach verified YAML optimization patches (`shrink` + `ARM64`) to PR comments | | `tier` | `auto` | Plan quota tier (`auto`, `free`, `pro`, `team`, `enterprise`, or `paid`) | | `prs-per-week` | `25` | Weekly PR volume for monthly run-rate projection | | `pushes-per-pr` | `4` | Average pushes per Pull Request | | `dev-hourly-rate` | `65` | Engineering hourly rate in USD for wait-time math (`0` disables wait-time cost) | | `live-telemetry` | `false` | Sync historical CI run durations prior to calculation | | `billing-csv` | `""` | Optional `FOCUS v1.1` or CI vendor billing CSV path for exact invoice lock | | `slack-webhook-url` | `""` | Optional Slack Incoming Webhook URL for Block Kit cost & diff alerts | **Key Outputs (`steps..outputs.*`):** `gross_monthly_compute_cost_usd`, `net_billed_monthly_compute_cost_usd`, `monthly_rounding_tax_usd`, `monthly_productive_payroll_loss_usd`, `arm64_migration_monthly_savings_usd`, `recoverable_ci_and_wait_monthly_usd`, `cost_per_merged_pr_usd`, `spend_anomaly_alert_active`, `provenance_mode` (+ 25 more in [action.yml](https://github.com/minici-dev/minici-cost-action/blob/main/action.yml)). --- ## Endpoints & Overrides MiniCI's hosted API origin is one config value, defaulting to `https://minici.dev`: | Surface | Override | Default | |---|---|---| | CLI (`minici share`, `minici comment`, cloud sync) | `MINICI_API_URL` env var (`MINICI_CLOUD_URL` is still read as a legacy alias) | `https://minici.dev` | | GitHub Action | `api-url` input (replaces the old `cloud-api-url` input) | `https://minici.dev` | | GitHub App / Slack manifests (`integrations/*-manifest.json`) | `{{MINICI_API_URL}}` placeholder, substituted before upload: `sed "s#{{MINICI_API_URL}}#$MINICI_API_URL#g" integrations/github-app-manifest.json` | `https://minici.dev` | | Blog generator (`tools/build_seo_blog_hub.py`) | `MINICI_API_URL` env var | `https://minici.dev` | Static pages in `web/` (blog canonicals, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`) hold the literal default origin, since they cannot read env vars. `web/setup-github-app.html` takes its origin from one `MINICI_API_URL` constant at the top of its script. Hostnames in use under `minici.dev`: - `minici.dev` (apex): the one official host. It serves the website (`web/`) and the Worker API through the `routes` in `wrangler.jsonc` (`custom_domain: true`). - `www.minici.dev`: 301-redirects to `https://minici.dev` (in `worker.js`). - The L1 report cache (`/v1/report/...`) uses `https://minici.dev/v1/report/...` only as a Cache API key. It is never fetched, so it needs no separate subdomain. There is no `api.` or `cache.` subdomain. ## Troubleshooting | Symptom | Cause & 1-Line Fix | | :--- | :--- | | **No sticky comment appeared on the PR** | Ensure `post-pr-comment: "true"`, `compare-to: "origin/${{ github.base_ref }}"`, and `permissions: pull-requests: write` are set. | | **PR diff reports all existing workflows as newly added** | `actions/checkout@v4` fetches only 1 commit by default. Add `with: fetch-depth: 0` so the base branch ref exists locally. | | **External fork or Dependabot PR has no comment** | Expected: GitHub restricts fork tokens to read-only. View the full receipt in the Actions **Job Summary** tab. | | **Minimal Docker/self-hosted runner missing `python3`** | `action.yml` uses `python3` to export the 34 `GITHUB_OUTPUT` fields; run the cost job on `ubuntu-latest` or ensure `python3` is installed. | | **Static estimate differs from a long wrapper script** | Add `# est-minutes: 30` to the job in YAML, or enable `live-telemetry: "true"` to pull real historical durations. | --- ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
1. Is MiniCI completely free? Do I need an API key or external account? Yes. MiniCI is free and open-source under `Apache-2.0`, with zero API keys, zero sign-ups, and all 227+ hosted CI runner and cloud VM rates compiled directly into the binary.
2. Will MiniCI ever fail or block my developers' Pull Requests? Never by default. MiniCI exits `0` and updates one sticky PR comment rather than spamming new comments on every push. Teams that want hard budget enforcement can optionally check `steps..outputs.*` in a subsequent step.
3. Does MiniCI clutter standard repos with irrelevant cloud egress or storage rows? No. MiniCI applies strict applicability filtering: artifact storage appears only when workflows upload artifacts, cloud NAT/VPC egress appears only on self-hosted cloud runners, and runner right-sizing tips trigger only where verified savings exist.
4. Does MiniCI work with GitLab CI, CircleCI, Bitbucket, CodeBuild, Cloud Build, or Azure Pipelines? Yes. While packaged on GitHub Marketplace as a turnkey GitHub Action, the `minici` CLI natively parses all 7 CI platforms (`.github/workflows/*.yml`, `.gitlab-ci.yml`, `.circleci/config.yml`, `bitbucket-pipelines.yml`, `buildspec.yml`, `cloudbuild.yaml`, `azure-pipelines.yml`) and translates pipelines across them via `minici migrate`.
5. How does minici shrink edit YAML without stripping comments? Instead of re-serializing YAML ASTs (which destroys comments and formatting), `minici shrink` applies surgical line-level patches that preserve 100% of `#` comments and verifies dollar savings via a shadow diff first.
6. What are the known static-analysis boundaries in offline mode? Local reusable workflows (`uses: ./.github/workflows/...`) resolve automatically without double-counting orchestrator jobs. Dynamic runtime matrices (`${{ fromJSON(...) }}`), YAML merge anchors (`<<: *base`), and cross-repository reusable workflows default to `1x` cardinality offline unless paired with `live-telemetry: "true"`. Full details in [CAPABILITIES_AND_LIMITATIONS.md](https://github.com/minici-dev/minici-cost-action/blob/main/docs/CAPABILITIES_AND_LIMITATIONS.md) and [BENCHMARK_217_CASES_3ARM_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/minici-dev/minici-cost-action/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARK_217_CASES_3ARM_RESULTS.md).
---
